verdict.rationale: The pack never documents token-by-token streaming. Mistral does document its own latency features: Predicted Outputs optimizes response time, prompt-cache hits reduce latency, and Priority Tier gives more predictable access under load. Hands-on community reports corroborate fast answers of about 1s versus 5-8s for other models, though not for web-search queries. Missing for 10: documented streaming (SSE/token-by-token) support, published latency figures or SLAs, and first-party evidence of sub-second full responses.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream responses token by token (or get sub-second full answers) with the latency behavior documented

citations.quote: Predicted Outputs optimizes response time by leveraging known or predictable content.
cache hits can reduce response latency by reusing part of the previous prompt computation.
Priority Tier gives eligible API requests priority queueing for workloads that need more predictable access to shared infrastructure.
Mistral's edge is speed—it answers in ~1s what takes other models 5-8s
